segments.text: Tony found the paper backside the laundromat machine
Said the age of air was coming
Said the planets must be clean
He drew a crooked little moon shot on a paper grocery sack
Then he cancelled soap and reason
Said he wouldn't need them back
Now he's charging jars of water
in the blue light of the moon he bought a crystal pendulum and hung it from the fan
it pointed at the kitchen so he called it destiny's plan he said every drop is sacred
every urge must be retained i can feel my hidden thunder getting polished in my brain
seven days of concentration 14 lectures in a row now he whispers to his trousers we got energy to
grow Tony's got an aura with a radius you can sense it coming down the hall he says major never
made a bar of soap and enlightenment don't wash it off Tony's got an aura with a radius cosmic
truth and something else besides he opens every window for the universe the universe takes one
sniffing high then he read about recycling what the body froze away raised a warm and cloudy
tumbler like a toaster brick of day said the fountain is internal and the proof is in the
taste his houseplants leaned away from him with dignity and haste at the market he wore linen and
a necklace made of seeds told the cashier modern bathing only manufacturers needs she held her
breath and scan the sage the incense and the lime while tony praised his natural smell for seven
solid minutes time baseline creeping floorboard speaking saturn rising friends advising maybe
rinse a little rich he laughs you fear vibration then the whole room changes chairs even peace
loving strangers suddenly discover urgent errands downstairs tony's got an aura with a radius you can
sense it coming down the hall he says mate you never made a bar of soap and enlightenment don't
wash it all so he's got an aura with the radius cosmic truth and something else besides he opens
every window for the universe the universe takes one sniff and hides one night beneath the moonlight
his crystal gave no sign he shook it over every jar and blamed the grand design
then a quiet thought came drifting clearer than his mystic brew if the cosmos lives in everything
maybe soap is cosmic too tony stood beneath the shower like a prophet in the rain watched a fort
night of ascension spiral laughing down the drain kept the breathing and the moonlight kept
the linen kept the seeds but retired the private tumbler and revised his daily needs
tony's got an aura with radius now it smells like cedar rain and lime he says wisdom isn't losing
every strange idea it's knowing when to change your mind tony's got an aura with the radius but
his friends can share the room again he leaves one crystal shining on the windowsill that's the
clean night air rolling let the clean night air roll in tony smiles and lets it in
